scope: CPU local static 810x1080 15FPS MP4, real YOLO/ByteTrack + API/Redis/PostgreSQL/snapshots/analytics + WS previews + SSE; not RTSP/GPU/production certification

comparison_plan.finding: regressions and recoverability gates; no performance improvement claim
comparison_plan.reason: Primary question is testing/audit, not trends or ranking; per-stage numbers retained as diagnostic evidence only.

method_notes: CSV grain is one persisted event, not person. line_id is intentionally null (only zone rules configured); note/acknowledged_at/false_positive_at are intentionally null (no operator edits in load). Status NEW is intentional. track_id is a non-additive identifier; profiler sum/day hint is rejected. processed_total is cumulative and must be differenced, never summed or interpreted as daily rate. ISO timestamps parsed UTC before validation.
Rows are ~5s samples; nested status and Prometheus samples stay raw. Constant camera count and zero error/drop fields are intentional, not missing data.
First CPU sample excluded: its psutil interval includes warmup/preceding stage. RSS/API quantiles are sampled diagnostics, not strict maxima or SLAs.

FPS uses complete-stage worker counter delta/wall seconds; independent adjacent-raw counter/time arithmetic must agree within3%. Latest-frame drops are intentional under capacity pressure, not event loss.

These are one sequential local-file run per stage, not a controlled before/after comparison, RTSP/GPU certification or a24h soak. Local latency is not sensor-to-browser; no latency percentiles inferred from the sampled latest-value gauge.
